units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Sabb. II, 1</cite> <he>פְּתִילַת האידן</he> a bast wick; <he>פ׳ המדבר</he> the wick of the desert, v. <cite ref="U00179"><he>שִׁבְרָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ הבגד</he> the wick made of rags of a garment. Ib. 5 <he>חוץ מן הפ׳</he> except when he has the intention of saving the wick; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּתִילוֹת</he>. Ib. 20ᵇ <he>עד כאן פסול פ׳</he> so far the Mishnah refers to wicks unfit for use on the Sabbath. Ib. 21ᵇ; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 58a:21">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי פ׳ בנר אחד</he> two wicks in one lamp (euphem. for adultery).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">Snh. VII, 2</cite> <he>ומדליק את הפ׳ וכ׳</he> and (the executioner) lights (heats) the string and throws it into his mouth; expl.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:9">ib. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ של אבר</he>, v. <cite ref="A00203"><he>אֲבָר</he></cite>; Y. ib. VII, 24ᵇ bot. <he>פ׳ של בעץ</he> a bar of plumbum album; (oth. opin.) <he>פ׳ של נפט</he> a wick dipped in naphtha.
<cite ref="Yevamot 6b:15">Yeb. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>בישול פ׳</he> boiling (melting) a bar of lead; <cite ref="Shabbat 106a:5">Sabb. 106ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:5">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>שהן דומין לפ׳ של אבר</he> (not <he>לפתילתא</he>) which burn in the stomach like a molten bar of lead.
